relation_statement: The learning rate applied at the first post-load step must equal the newly configured scheduler value (not the checkpoint value) under guard G = checkpoint resumed with --override-opt_param-scheduler.
observable_signal: learning rate used at first step after load vs configured LR
validity_precondition: resume from checkpoint with override-opt_param-scheduler and a changed LR config
evidence_from_issue: first training step still uses the old learning rate from the checkpoint instead of the new configured value
evidence_from_fix: override flag ignored on first step; old LR loaded from checkpoint takes precedence

relation_statement: The reused gradient buffer must remain uncorrupted by the concurrent param all-gather under guard G = MXFP8 param gather with buffer reuse but no overlapped comm.
observable_signal: NaN loss / corrupted gradient-buffer values
validity_precondition: --fp8-param-gather + --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag without --overlap-grad-reduce/--overlap-param-gather
evidence_from_issue: gradient buffer corruption leading to NaN
evidence_from_fix: gradient buffer reuse conflicts with non-overlapped communication

relation_statement: The MLA attention output must equal the correct reference attention computation under guard G = Multi-head Latent Attention on megatron-core 0.10.0.
observable_signal: abnormal loss patterns vs expected loss trajectory
validity_precondition: MLA enabled
evidence_from_issue: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss values ... abnormal loss patterns
evidence_from_fix: incorrect attention computation

relation_statement: The global MoE aux-loss gradient must be scaled by dp_size to compensate averaging over the global token count under guard G = global_aux_loss with DP>1.
observable_signal: aux-loss gradient magnitude (off by 1/dp_size factor)
validity_precondition: num_experts>=2, global_aux_loss balancing, aux-loss-coeff>0, DP>1
evidence_from_issue: divides by the entire DP group's token count instead of local micro-batch count, shrinking aux-loss gradients by ~DP world-size
evidence_from_fix: global_aux_loss not multiplied by dp_size before attaching gradient; gradient 1/dp_size too small

relation_statement: The reduce-scatter must launch only after the DDP grad post-hook completes (same-stream ordering) under guard G = overlap-grad-reduce with >1 distributed-optimizer instances.
observable_signal: reduce-scatter launched before hook completes; silently incorrect gradient values
validity_precondition: --overlap-grad-reduce and --num-distributed-optimizer-instances>1
evidence_from_issue: reduce-scatter to launch before hook completion producing silently incorrect gradient values
evidence_from_fix: post-hook executes on a side CUDA stream due to expand_as inheriting stream affinity

relation_statement: The fused-attention backward dQ must equal the reference (unfused) dQ within tolerance under guard G = TE fused attention with deep models under TP.
observable_signal: relative error of dQ vs reference (>1.0)
validity_precondition: Transformer Engine fused attention backward on deep models
evidence_from_issue: fused_attn_bwd produces dQ with relative error >1.0 for deep models
evidence_from_fix: silently corrupting gradients when using TE fused attention with TP

relation_statement: Tokens must not attend across document boundaries (block-diagonal mask honored, not defaulted to causal) under guard G = packed-sequence training with TE backend.
observable_signal: cross-document attention leakage / mask type applied
validity_precondition: transformer_engine backend with packed sequences and block-diagonal attention_mask
evidence_from_issue: TE layer defaults to attn_mask_type='causal' and silently ignores the block-diagonal attention_mask
evidence_from_fix: cross-document attention leakage during packed-sequence training

relation_statement: The RoPE frequency layout must match the rotary_interleaved application logic (config forwarded) under guard G = MultiLatentAttention with rotary_interleaved=True.
observable_signal: RoPE frequency layout (half-half vs interleaved) applied to positional encoding
validity_precondition: MLA with rotary_interleaved=True (YarnRotaryEmbedding)
evidence_from_issue: RoPE frequency format mismatch when rotary_interleaved=True
evidence_from_fix: YarnRotaryEmbedding instantiated without forwarding rotary_interleaved; half-half layout applied with interleaved logic

relation_statement: The MoE gate tensor must be partitioned across TP ranks (each rank holds its slice) under guard G = kv_head < tp_size.
observable_signal: whether each TP rank uses its gate slice vs the full gate
validity_precondition: MoE with kv_head < tp_size
evidence_from_issue: gate tensor not partitioned across TP ranks when kv_head < tp_size
evidence_from_fix: all TP ranks use the full gate instead of their slice, producing incorrect routing decisions

relation_statement: The gradient buffer must be zeroed (finish_param_sync) before the first accumulation so initial parameter values do not pollute grads under guard G = reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag with forward_pre_hook disabled.
observable_signal: non-zero gradient buffer contents at first iteration
validity_precondition: reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag with forward_pre_hook disabled, first iteration
evidence_from_issue: finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration
evidence_from_fix: initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently

relation_statement: A saved checkpoint must contain the complete optimizer state (including exp_avg) under guard G = checkpoint saved at an early iteration (save-interval=20).
observable_signal: presence/absence of 'exp_avg' key in saved optimizer state dict
validity_precondition: checkpoint save at early iteration before optimizer state populated
evidence_from_issue: optimizer state dict is missing 'exp_avg' key
evidence_from_fix: optimizer state hasn't been properly populated at early save points, leading to corrupt checkpoints

relation_statement: The aux-loss tracker must be incremented exactly once per training step (not on recompute passes) under guard G = activation checkpointing reruns the router forward.
observable_signal: logged aux-loss value doubled / number of tracker increments per step
validity_precondition: MoE TopKRouter training=True with activation recompute enabled
evidence_from_issue: aux loss tracker accumulates twice when activation checkpointing reruns router
evidence_from_fix: router checked only self.training not torch.is_grad_enabled(); incremented in both normal and recompute passes, doubling logged values

relation_statement: group_limited_topk must compute group scores with k = num_groups//group_topk (not hardcoded 2) so correct groups are selected under guard G = group-limited routing with moe_router_group_topk set.
observable_signal: group scores / selected expert groups vs expected
validity_precondition: MoE with moe_router_group_topk and num_groups configured (DeepSeek-style)
evidence_from_issue: group_limited_topk used hardcoded k=2 instead of num_groups/group_topk
evidence_from_fix: k=2 hardcoded produced wrong group scores and wrong group selection for token-to-expert routing

relation_statement: ViT self-attention must be bidirectional (no_mask) and identical across the TE and local layer-spec paths under guard G = ViT/CLIP encoder built via local (non-TE) spec.
observable_signal: attention mask type (causal vs no_mask) applied to patch tokens
validity_precondition: ViT/CLIP encoder via get_vit_layer_with_local_spec (multimodal LLaVA-style)
evidence_from_issue: local layer spec uses AttnMaskType.causal instead of no_mask, turning bidirectional self-attention into causal
evidence_from_fix: TE path already correct (no_mask); local path applied lower-triangular mask so each patch attends only to earlier patches

relation_statement: The source activation buffer must not be deallocated until the async P2P send completes (wait on send handle) under guard G = interleaved 1F1B with async P2P and deallocate_pipeline_outputs.
observable_signal: corrupted activations received at next pipeline stage / missing send-wait
validity_precondition: interleaved 1F1B, deallocate_pipeline_outputs=True, overlap_p2p_communication
evidence_from_issue: forgets to wait on async P2P send before deallocating the source buffer, sending corrupted activations to next stage
evidence_from_fix: issued isend then immediately called deallocate_output_tensor without waiting on send_next_wait_handle

relation_statement: get_grads_for_norm must read the actual gradient source (decoupled_grad under precision-aware optimizer, not param.grad._local_tensor) under guard G = Megatron-FSDP + precision-aware optimizer.
observable_signal: global grad norm value (zero/stale) used for clipping and logging
validity_precondition: Megatron-FSDP params with precision-aware optimizer and grad-norm clipping
evidence_from_issue: reads param.grad._local_tensor instead of decoupled_grad and computes the wrong norm
evidence_from_fix: fsdp_param branch checked BEFORE precision-aware branch; param.grad is None/stale, grad norm used wrong (zero) tensors, silently disabling clipping

relation_statement: The attention forward must apply the configured softmax_scale (not a default) under guard G = config.softmax_scale set.
observable_signal: softmax scaling factor applied in attention scores
validity_precondition: config.softmax_scale specified
evidence_from_issue: config.softmax_scale ignored in attention forward paths
evidence_from_fix: (no root_cause text provided) softmax_scale config not propagated to attention

relation_statement: The attention and FFN paths must use separate normalization modules (FFN uses norm2, not the shared norm) under guard G = sequential transformer block.
observable_signal: whether FFN path uses norm2 vs shared self.norm (coupled norm parameters)
validity_precondition: sequential block type
evidence_from_issue: attention 和 FFN 路径共享了同一个 LayerNorm（self.norm），而 FFN 路径应该使用 self.norm2
evidence_from_fix: 两路归一化参数耦合

relation_statement: The residual connection must add the original (un-normed) input, not the normed input under guard G = sequential block with pre-norm (norm_after=False).
observable_signal: initial loss magnitude (surged from 10 to 60)
validity_precondition: block_type='sequential', norm_after=False (pre-norm default)
evidence_from_issue: Attention norm 在应用之前意外修改了残差流，导致初始 loss 从 10 暴增到 60
evidence_from_fix: x = self.attn_norm(x) overwrites the residual variable; residual connection uses normed input instead of original input

relation_statement: The FSDP gradient reduction must preserve sufficient precision (not bfloat16) so output logit norm stays bounded under guard G = multi-node (>4 nodes) mixed-precision training.
observable_signal: output logit norm growth / PPL becoming Inf
validity_precondition: FSDP mixed precision with reduce_dtype=bfloat16 at scale (>4 nodes)
evidence_from_issue: reduce_dtype=bfloat16 在多节点训练时导致 output logit norm 持续增长，最终 PPL 出现 Inf，但 loss 仍然正常
evidence_from_fix: low-precision (bfloat16) gradient reduction accumulates error at scale

relation_statement: The data-loader start_index must reset to 0 when entering a new epoch under guard G = resume with restore_dataloader=False.
observable_signal: data samples skipped at new epoch (start_index not 0)
validity_precondition: new epoch after checkpoint resume with restore_dataloader=False
evidence_from_issue: start_index 在进入新 epoch 时未被重置为 0，导致部分数据被跳过
evidence_from_fix: global_step not reset to 0 when restore_dataloader=False

relation_statement: Padding tokens (ignore_index) must be excluded from the loss under guard G = flash-attn >= 2.5.8 cross_entropy_loss API.
observable_signal: padding tokens contributing to loss (ignore_index not effective)
validity_precondition: flash-attn >=2.5.8 cross_entropy_loss with renamed ignore_index parameter
evidence_from_issue: flash-attn 将参数名从 ignored_index 改为 ignore_index，OLMo 未同步，ignore_index 未生效，padding token 被错误计入 loss
evidence_from_fix: stale parameter name meant ignore_index was silently ignored

relation_statement: The optimizer state['step'] must increment by 1 each optimizer step so Adam bias correction advances under guard G = SkipStepAdamW.
observable_signal: step counter stuck at 0 / effective LR ~2.2x configured
validity_precondition: SkipStepAdamW optimizer
evidence_from_issue: state['step'] 从未被递增，Adam bias correction 始终使用 step=0，有效学习率是设定值的 2.2 倍
evidence_from_fix: optimizer step counter stays at 0, biasing Adam bias correction

relation_statement: Each block must use its own CP-sharded RoPE buffer (distinct per shard), not a reused identical buffer, under guard G = context parallelism enabled.
observable_signal: identical RoPE buffer reused across blocks instead of per-shard positions
validity_precondition: context parallelism with per-block RoPE buffers
evidence_from_issue: 不同 block 复用了相同的 RoPE buffer，导致所有 block 使用相同的位置编码而非各自分片后的位置编码
evidence_from_fix: blocks reused identical RoPE buffers in context parallelism

relation_statement: Under TP the fused-linear ce_loss/z_loss must be combined as local tensors and w_out must carry the TP wrapper so FSDP param distribution is consistent, under guard G = LMHead fused_linear loss with TP.
observable_signal: loss values / param distribution inconsistency under TP
validity_precondition: LMHead with fused_linear loss under tensor parallelism
evidence_from_issue: ce_loss 和 z_loss 被错误地作为 distributed tensor 组合（应作为 local tensor），w_out 缺少 TP wrapper
evidence_from_fix: wrong distributed tensor handling for ce_loss/z_loss; FSDP 参数分布不一致

relation_statement: Reported training metrics must be fully reduced so all ranks agree (not partially-reduced on non-zero ranks) under guard G = distributed training with DP>1.
observable_signal: metric values differing across ranks (partially-reduced)
validity_precondition: metric logging across ranks
evidence_from_issue: 非 rank-0 进程报告的 training metrics 是部分 reduce 的值，各 rank 看到不同的 metric 值
evidence_from_fix: Throughput metrics not using reduce_type=max -> partially-reduced values on non-zero ranks

relation_statement: The loss normalization denominator (unmasked token count) must be >0 so the loss stays finite under guard G = instance masking with all tokens masked in a batch.
observable_signal: NaN loss from division by zero
validity_precondition: instance masking where a batch can have all tokens masked
evidence_from_issue: 当 batch 中所有 token 都被 mask 时导致除以零产生 NaN loss
evidence_from_fix: instance masking 实现除以零

relation_statement: The optimizer param_groups must have initial_lr set/restored after checkpoint load so the LR scheduler resumes correctly under guard G = checkpoint resume.
observable_signal: LR warmup starting from wrong LR after resume
validity_precondition: resume from checkpoint with LR scheduler
evidence_from_issue: 从 checkpoint 加载后 optimizer 的初始学习率没有被重置为配置值，warmup 从错误的 LR 起点开始
evidence_from_fix: Missing initial_lr in param_groups breaks LR scheduler after checkpoint resume

relation_statement: The CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler must produce LR values matching the specified warmup/decay schedule under guard G = scheduler initialization.
observable_signal: LR values deviating from expected schedule shape
validity_precondition: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler
evidence_from_issue: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay 学习率 scheduler 的初始化逻辑错误，学习率 schedule 不符合预期
evidence_from_fix: scheduler initialization bug

relation_statement: The block's computed result must be invariant whether activation checkpointing/recompute is enabled, under guard G = ReorderedNormTransformerBlock with fine-grained FSDP wrapping + activation checkpointing.
observable_signal: incorrect computation results when both features combined
validity_precondition: ReorderedNormTransformerBlock with fine-grained FSDP wrapping and activation checkpointing
evidence_from_issue: 同时使用 fine-grained FSDP wrapping 和 activation checkpointing 时出现交互 bug，产生不正确的计算结果
evidence_from_fix: FSDP wrapping + activation checkpointing interaction bug

relation_statement: The evaluator data-loader bookkeeping must reset between runs so data order is identical across repeated eval runs under guard G = repeated LM evaluator runs.
observable_signal: data order differing between repeated eval runs
validity_precondition: LM evaluator run repeatedly within a session
evidence_from_issue: data loader 在重复运行间存在数据顺序漂移，bookkeeping state 未被正确重置
evidence_from_fix: loader bookkeeping reset fixes data-order drift across repeated runs

relation_statement: When downsampling a source file the loader must draw a random sample, not truncate to the first N rows, under guard G = SourceMixtureDataset requiring sampling.
observable_signal: selected rows are the file prefix rather than a random subset
validity_precondition: SourceMixtureDataset sampling from source files
evidence_from_issue: 错误地截断源文件而非随机采样，导致训练只使用了每个源文件的前 N 条数据
evidence_from_fix: truncating source files instead of randomly sampling
